Project Name: Memorial Hermann Katy Hospital West Tower OR Buildout
Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: Neuro OR 15 & General OR 16 buildout to the existing surgery department of Memorial Hermann Katy Hospital; Interior renovation of additional PACU bay and converting recovery bay 24 & 25 into private recovery. Estimate of square footage is 2692 SF.
